value.value: The authors hypothesize high surface energy of small cubic NCs stabilizes a kinetically trapped high-pressure-like structure at ambient pressure. This is a mechanistic interpretation, not a measured formation free energy. Prior bulk heating at 300 °C for a few hours is cited background rather than the current colloidal route.

value.value: Previously published CsMnCl3 work is discussed separately: nonemissive reports, emission around654–660 nm, Guan660 nm with0.7% QY, and Hao Zn-doped improvement from56 to77%.
